title: Improve appearance of popup with colored backgrounds when placed in a panel
line: A coloured Sticky Note in a panel now fills its whole popup, with no grey border around it.
explanation: In a panel, the Sticky Note's full representation is the note SVG (paper plus its own transparent margins of about 7%) placed inside the popup's padding, so the coloured paper sat inside the grey dialog frame with a wide border around it. When the note is shown in an AppletPopup and isn't transparent, the paper is now drawn under the popup's padding up to its edges, scaled so the SVG's own margins fall outside, and masked with the same dialogs/background frame the popup uses so it keeps the popup's rounded corners. The note's text and buttons then use the popup's normal padding instead of the extra 7% margins.

commits.message:
applets/notes: fill the whole popup with the note's colour

In a panel, a coloured note was drawn as a small sticky note inside the
grey frame of its popup. The note's paper now covers the whole popup,
following the popup's own rounded shape, so it no longer has a border.

BUG: 403468

patches.diff:
From 72fa86acd1107f14a0821007f7e95d25724ef866 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:58:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notes: fill the whole popup with the note's colour

In a panel, a coloured note was drawn as a small sticky note inside the
grey frame of its popup. The note's paper now covers the whole popup,
following the popup's own rounded shape, so it no longer has a border.

BUG: 403468
---
 applets/notes/qml/main.qml | 59 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----
 1 file changed, 54 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
index 63a6409ba..367d627ad 100644
--- a/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notes/qml/main.qml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2 // just for desktop-styled context menus
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 import QtQuick.Window
 import QtQuick.Dialogs
+import QtQuick.Effects
 
 import org.kde.draganddrop as DragDrop
 
@@ -117,6 +118,8 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         readonly property QtObject appletInterface: root
 
         property alias mainTextArea: mainTextArea
+        readonly property PlasmaCore.AppletPopup popup: Window.window as PlasmaCore.AppletPopup
+        readonly property bool fillsPopup: !root.noBackground && popup !== null
         // TODO figure out what element is missing in the requiredWidth calculation...
         Layout.minimumWidth: {
             if (root.inPanel && !root.compactInPanel) {
@@ -133,9 +136,55 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                                 : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2
         }
 
-        imagePath: root.noBackground ? "" : "widgets/notes"
+        imagePath: root.noBackground || fillsPopup ? "" : "widgets/notes"
         elementId: Plasmoid.configuration.color + "-notes"
 
+        Item {
+            id: popupBackground
+            anchors {
+                fill: parent
+                leftMargin: -(backgroundItem.popup?.leftPadding ?? 0)
+                rightMargin: -(backgroundItem.popup?.rightPadding ?? 0)
+                topMargin: -(backgroundItem.popup?.topPadding ?? 0)
+                bottomMargin: -(backgroundItem.popup?.bottomPadding ?? 0)
+            }
+            visible: backgroundItem.fillsPopup
+
+            layer.enabled: visible
+            layer.effect: MultiEffect {
+                maskEnabled: true
+                maskSource: popupShape
+                maskThresholdMin: 0.5
+                maskSpreadAtMin: 1.0
+            }
+
+            // Leave the note's own margins out, so only the paper fills the popup
+            KSvg.SvgItem {
+                x: -width * 0.07
+                y: -height * 0.07
+                width: parent.width / 0.86
+                height: parent.height / 0.86
+                imagePath: "widgets/notes"
+                elementId: backgroundItem.elementId
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Same shape as the popup's own background, so the note follows its rounded corners
+        KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+            id: popupShape
+            anchors.fill: popupBackground
+            visible: false
+            layer.enabled: backgroundItem.fillsPopup
+            imagePath: "dialogs/background"
+            enabledBorders: {
+                const edges = backgroundItem.popup?.borders ?? 0;
+                return ((edges & Qt.TopEdge) ? KSvg.FrameSvg.TopBorder : 0)
+                    | ((edges & Qt.BottomEdge) ? KSvg.FrameSvg.BottomBorder : 0)
+                    | ((edges & Qt.LeftEdge) ? KSvg.FrameSvg.LeftBorder : 0)
+                    | ((edges & Qt.RightEdge) ? KSvg.FrameSvg.RightBorder : 0);
+            }
+        }
+
         DocumentHandler {
             id: documentHandler
             target: mainTextArea
@@ -159,10 +208,10 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             id: focusScope
             anchors {
                 fill: parent
-                leftMargin: root.noBackground ? 0 : root.horizontalMargins
-                rightMargin: root.noBackground ? 0 : root.horizontalMargins
-                topMargin: root.noBackground ? 0 : root.verticalMargins
-                bottomMargin: root.noBackground ? 0 : root.verticalMargins
+                leftMargin: root.noBackground || backgroundItem.fillsPopup ? 0 : root.horizontalMargins
+                rightMargin: root.noBackground || backgroundItem.fillsPopup ? 0 : root.horizontalMargins
+                topMargin: root.noBackground || backgroundItem.fillsPopup ? 0 : root.verticalMargins
+                bottomMargin: root.noBackground || backgroundItem.fillsPopup ? 0 : root.verticalMargins
             }
 
             PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
--
